question: how many DISTINCT structures are in the survivor set?

overlap.measure: pairwise Jaccard on the overlap-restricted treated membership
overlap.components: connected components of the J >= 0.50 graph
overlap.subset: A is a strict subset of B iff |A & B| == |A| and |A| < |B|

medoid.rule: the member with the MAXIMUM MEAN JACCARD to the other members of its component
medoid.forbidden: choosing the representative by Z, by magnitude, or by support — survivor selection already used Y once; a second selection inside the component would compound it
medoid.singletons: a one-member component is its own medoid

outcome_free.why: the survivor set is already a selection on Y; structure must not add a second one

denominators_required: survivors per position family DIVIDED BY eligible claims per position family
P(survive | claim contains M1:L3) vs P(survive | it does not)
interpretation_limits: a survivor count is not a count of independent discoveries
position-family dominance is not established without its denominator
a motif appearing at the top of a Z-ordered table may be one correlated cluster rather than a repeated structure
descriptive_only: every incidence statistic here is POST-EXPOSURE DESCRIPTIVE CHARACTERIZATION, never a new promotion test
